description:
REQUIRES: opi-fin.6.5 (Host fully wired) merged.

FILE: apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/command_context.ex

CommandContext.t() has 6 session navigation fn-fields: wait_for_idle, new_session, fork, navigate_tree, switch_session, reload. These follow the same stub/bind pattern as API.t() and UIContext.t().

STEP 1 -- AUDIT (do this before any code changes):
grep -r 'CommandContext' apps/ to find all callers.
Expected finding: CommandContext is used only in the CLI/session runner layer, NOT by any extensions. Confirm this.

STEP 2 -- DECISION based on audit:
A) If no extensions use CommandContext session actions: these are CLI-layer concerns, not extension concerns. Document this in command_context.ex moduledoc. No migration needed for the extension framework. Leave the fn-field pattern in place since it is not part of the extension author API.

B) If extensions DO use CommandContext actions: fold those actions into the Host behaviour (new_session, fork, etc. become Host callbacks). Follow the same migration pattern as Phase 6.

Document the audit finding and decision in this ticket before closing.
title: Audit and resolve CommandContext
